title: Initial configuration of the tabulating machine
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, and let $y$ be a finite Boolean input. The initial configuration of the machine constructed from $M$ has its simulated state register set to the initial state of $M$ with an empty output register, its input head at position $1$ clamped to the range of positions for $y$, all work-tape cells blank, all work-tape heads at the origin, and an empty output tape.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet
